title: Fires Secretary of State Rex Tillerson
description_short: Trump fired Rex Tillerson as Secretary of State and nominated Mike Pompeo to replace him.
description_medium: Donald Trump removed Secretary of State Rex Tillerson on March 13, 2018, and nominated CIA Director Mike Pompeo to replace him. Contemporary reports described policy tensions between the two men but did not establish a single cause for Tillerson’s departure. Pompeo still required Senate confirmation before he could take office.
